6:
Direct Eligibility and Offer Flow - V0
The Direct path moves from intake through Eligibility Gate. Pass allows preliminary line calculation and offer presentation. Evidence Required and Specialist Review can loop back after resolution. Acceptance moves the application to Final Underwriting rather than directly to approval.
Decision paths:
- Direct Intake -> Eligibility Gate
- Eligibility Gate -> Gate Result
- Gate Result --Pass--> Preliminary Line
- Preliminary Line -> Present Offer
- Present Offer --accepted--> Final Underwriting
- Gate Result --Evidence Required--> Evidence Required
- Evidence Required --resolved--> Eligibility Gate
- Gate Result --Specialist Review--> Specialist Review
- Specialist Review --cleared--> Eligibility Gate
- Gate Result --Decline--> Send Decision Notice -> Close Application
7:
Verified Partner Final Underwriting Flow - V0
Version 0 calculates the preliminary line before enhanced fraud review. The flow then evaluates account ownership, identity validity, and Funding Readiness. A pass at any intermediate gate only permits continuation.
Decision paths:
- Verified Partner Eligibility --Pass--> Calculate Preliminary Line
- Calculate Preliminary Line -> Enhanced Fraud Review
- Enhanced Fraud Review --Clear--> Final Underwriting Checks
- Final Underwriting --Pass--> Account Ownership
- Account Ownership --mismatch--> Evidence Required
- Evidence Required --resolved--> Account Ownership
- Account Ownership --resolved--> Funding Readiness
- Funding Readiness --complete--> Ready to Fund
